meta.title: Čakula iz Kužine: private chef in Istria
meta.description: A private chef for up to six guests. I turn local ingredients in season into fine dining in your home or villa in Istria.

hero.title: What's in season is on your table.
hero.lead: I come to your home or villa and cook for up to six guests. I turn local ingredients into dinner with restaurant-level precision, from the first plate to a kitchen left clean.
hero.badge: From the market and the fishmonger.

intro.title: Local, in season.
paragraphs: My kitchen starts at the market. I shop at local markets, from fishermen and fishmongers, and I try to keep the meat local or Croatian. What is best that morning shapes the menu, not the other way round.
I prepare those ingredients with modern techniques. I want to bring fine dining into your home. That means precise preparation, calm service, and a kitchen I leave clean at the end.

how.title: You choose the date. I cook.
how.lead: The arrangement is simple. You choose the date and the guests, and everything else is my job.

steps.title: Choose a date and a place
steps.text: Tell me when and where: a home, a villa, a terrace. I bring my own knives and basic equipment.

steps.title: We plan the menu
steps.text: We talk about tastes, allergies, and the occasion. I suggest a menu, and you confirm it.

steps.title: I cook, you enjoy
steps.text: I arrive early, prepare, and serve, and I leave the kitchen clean at the end.

included.title: Everything dinner needs. Nothing in your way.
included.lead: One price, one arrangement. No hidden costs, and the tidying up stays with me.

items.name: Ana & Marko

faq.title: Good to know before you book.
faq.lead: If something isn't answered here, ask me on Take a Chef. I reply quickly.

items.q: How many guests do you cook for?
items.a: Up to six guests. For larger groups, get in touch and we'll find a solution.
I cook across Istria and, by arrangement, further afield. Travel costs depend on the location and are agreed in advance.

items.q: What do you need in the kitchen?
items.a: An ordinary home kitchen with a stove and an oven is enough. If something specific is needed, I'll let you know in advance.

items.q: How do you handle allergies and dietary needs?
items.a: I adapt the menu for allergies, intolerances, and dietary needs. Please tell me before we confirm the menu.
Usually three to four hours, depending on the number of courses and the pace of the evening.
You book through my Take a Chef profile. You choose a date and send an enquiry there, and we arrange the details afterwards.

items.q: Do you leave the kitchen clean?
items.a: Yes. The dishes are washed and the kitchen is tidied.

cta.title: Your dinner starts with one enquiry.
cta.lead: Check availability, choose a date, and send me a few details. I'll come back with a menu proposal.
